item.title: Fleet-wide computer vision lifecycle at the edge with SageMaker SDK v3
item.description: Fleet-wide computer vision needs a model per camera, not one model for the whole fleet. This post presents a working Amazon SageMaker SDK v3 reference architecture that trains, quality-gates, compiles per-camera models with SageMaker Neo, and versions thousands of them, with an AWS Step Functions layer pacing fleet-scale retraining within account quotas. — 来源：aws_ml — 原文：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/fleet-wide-computer-vision-lifecycle-at-the-edge-with-sagemaker-sdk-v3/

item.title: Quoting Jason Koebler
item.description: Because big tech platforms essentially do not have customer support and make it impossible for their users to contact a human, many people experiencing run-of-the-mill tech problems have turned to ChatGPT. And, increasingly, ChatGPT is telling people that have normal tech support problems that they have discovered something journalistically notable and that 404 Media, specifically, can help them. — Jason Koebler , ChatGPT Keeps Telling People 404 Media Can Solve Their Tech Support Problems Tags: jason-koebler , openai , journalism , ai , llms , ai-ethics , ai-misuse , generative-ai , chatgpt , — 来源：github · hn_frontpage · simonwillison — 原文：https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/26/jason-koebler/
